title: Lily Pad Pond

serves.summary: The learner hops a frog and a grasshopper along numbered lily pads by different jump sizes and puts flowers where both land, first with hops and then by reasoning alone, which shows multiples and common multiples (4 and 6 first meet at 12, not 24).

request.objective: Generate multiples of one-digit numbers and find common multiples of two numbers, including the least one, within 40 (4.OA.B.4).

problems.ask: The frog jumps 3 pads at a time and the grasshopper jumps 4. Put a flower on the first pad they both land on.
Now the frog jumps 4 and the grasshopper jumps 6. Put a flower on the first pad they both land on.
The frog jumps 6 and the grasshopper jumps 9. Put a flower on every pad up to 40 that they both land on.
The animals are asleep. The frog would jump 5 and the grasshopper 7. Put a flower on the first pad they would both land on.
